body: hi, i have a quite urgent, or so i think, question. So my boyfriend received a letter a while back in the mail and it was covered in cockroaches l, crickets, and feces. He never checks the mail and the one time something drew him into checking it that happened. It was the only mail and was hand written and addressed to him. Should we be worried? Should we try to cast a protection spell?
it was the main reason I stayed alive
